addSources.summary: Federal court case page for Jackson-Edney v. Labrador (refreshed 2026-11-25). Records the June 16, 2026 preliminary injunction and provisional class-action status blocking most of HB 752, the July 16, 2026 state appeal with the injunction remaining in place, and the Ninth Circuit briefing schedule through October 2026.

appendSummaryFacts: In the Ninth Circuit appeal in Jackson-Edney v. Labrador, the state's opening brief was filed on 28 August 2026, the plaintiff-appellee's opposition on 9 October 2026, and amicus briefs from state and civil-rights groups on 16 October 2026; the injunction remains in place pending appeal.

On June 16, 2026, a federal judge granted a preliminary injunction and provisional class-action status in Jackson-Edney v. Labrador. The injunction blocks the restroom portion of HB 752: a trans person may use public restrooms consistent with gender identity, except a multi-user restroom may still be enforced against when a single-user restroom is available on the same floor. The changing-room portion is not blocked.
The State of Idaho filed a notice of appeal on July 16, 2026; the injunction remains in place pending appeal.
HB 752 penalties escalate: first offence a misdemeanour (up to one year), second offence a felony (up to five years).
